commercial_building_character: Predominantly residential; strict planning controls have retained a village atmosphere. Local shops sit around the railway station; the major shopping hub of Box Hill is two train stops away.
verbatim_source_quotes: The area is protected by strict planning controls restricting development and has retained a village atmosphere.
The major shopping hub of Box Hill is two train stops away, while three buses connect Blackburn to Forest Hill.
Blackburn railway station was built in 1882.
